# Paths the content guard protects (.github/workflows/content-guard.yml).
# An agent PR that changes any of them fails the guard until Dan adds the content-ok label.
#
# One glob per line: * matches within a folder, ** matches across folders.
# The guard reads this file from main, so a PR can't change the list it's checked against.

resume/resume.yaml
src/content/**

# The loop's own rules and checks
CLAUDE.md

.github/**
